crop_patch_mouth: crop mouth patches from video frames using face landmark metadata and mean face alignment
split_video_to_frames: split a video file into individual frames at a specified fps using ffmpeg
download_video_from_youtube: download a video from YouTube given its video ID and save as mp4
normalize_text: normalize text by removing punctuation, parenthetical expressions, and converting to lowercase
read_av_manifest: read a TSV audio-video manifest file and return a pandas DataFrame with frame counts
